home.title: Indonesia's Social Forestry approval data

home.recordsNote: One record is one row in the GoKUPS register. This is not a count of groups or institutions.
home.areaNote: Sum of the Luas Area Keseluruhan (total area) column across {used} records. In {flagged} records the total area differs by more than 5 ha from the sum of its parts. These records carry a note but are still counted.
home.membersNote: Calculated from {used} records, including those with 0. {notUsedCount, plural, one {# record} other {# records}} could not be calculated ({reasons}).
home.membersCompare: For comparison, the source column Anggota Keseluruhan (total members) adds up to {sourceTotal}. In {mismatch} records, that column equals the number of women.

statistics.title: Statistics
statistics.lead: Summary of Social Forestry approval and designation records by PS type and by region. You can filter by region, PS type, or decree year. Every chart and table below follows those filters.
statistics.unitNote: Figures on this page count decree records for approval or designation holders. They are not counts of groups. Some Hutan Tanaman Rakyat records are individual permits, and some institutions appear under more than one decree number. Hutan Adat (customary forest) is recorded as a designation.

statistics.toRecords: See these {count} records on the Data page
statistics.sexTableNote: Men and women are counted over the same records as Members (M+W), so the two always add up to Members (M+W). The last column shows how many records list 0 women.

data.membersHint: Men + women, calculated by Data KUPS.
data.membersNote: This filter uses the number of men + women recorded in the source. That number is not an official status. The source does not mark individual permits consistently: the Bentuk Lembaga (institution type) column says “PERORANGAN” (individual) in only {perorangan} records. Most records with 1 member are Hutan Tanaman Rakyat (community plantation forest) permits that are probably held by individuals. 0 members may mean the number was not recorded.
data.pendampingHint: Based on whether the source Pendamping (facilitator) column is filled in.
data.pendampingNote: This filter checks whether the Pendamping (facilitator) column in the GoKUPS data is filled in. Facilitator names appear on the record detail page and in downloads, as recorded in the source. An empty column may mean the group has no facilitator, or that the facilitator was not recorded.
data.regionHint: Island group from the workbook's Region column. This column is not a GoKUPS field.

about.title: About the data
about.lead: Where the data in Data KUPS comes from, how the figures are calculated, and the limits to know before you use it.
about.purposeBody: Data KUPS publishes Indonesia's Social Forestry approval and designation records so they are easy to search, compare across regions, and download for research or presentations. Data KUPS is a data publication site. Applications, verification, and decree issuance still take place in GoKUPS and other official government systems.
about.sourceBody: All records come from the Social Forestry register and decree detail pages in GoKUPS, retrieved on {date}. At that time GoKUPS reported {reported} decrees, and {rows} rows were retrieved.
about.sourcePeriod: Decree dates in this data range from {from} to {to}.
about.sourceUpdate: Data KUPS is not connected to GoKUPS directly. The manager imports new data in a controlled way, and each import becomes a numbered release. Release shown now: {version}, built {built}.
about.unitBody: One record is one row in the GoKUPS register: one Social Forestry approval or one Hutan Adat (customary forest) designation. So Data KUPS figures count decree records. They are not counts of groups or institutions.
about.unitHtr: Some Hutan Tanaman Rakyat records are individual permits, so one record can be one individual permit holder.
about.unitShared: One decree number can be used by several records, and one institution can appear under more than one decree number. Data KUPS does not merge such records.
about.schemesLead: Summaries use five PS types. The definitions below are only summaries. The official reference is Minister of Environment and Forestry Regulation No. 9 of 2021 on Social Forestry Management. Scheme names are kept in Indonesian.

def.HD: Hutan Desa (village forest): forest area without an existing permit, managed by a village for the village's welfare.
def.HKM: Hutan Kemasyarakatan (community forestry): forest area used mainly to empower local communities.
def.HTR: Hutan Tanaman Rakyat (community plantation forest): plantation forest in production forest, established by community groups or individuals to improve the forest's potential and quality.
def.HA: Hutan Adat (customary forest): forest within the territory of a customary law community. Data KUPS records it as a designation, not an approval.
def.KK: Kemitraan Kehutanan (forestry partnership): cooperation between local communities and forest managers or permit holders in forest areas. The source splits it into three subtypes, which are always shown separately:

kkSub.KK_KULIN: Kulin KK (recognition and protection of forestry partnerships)

about.processingFidelity: Source values are not changed. Names, decree numbers, dates, areas, and member counts appear as recorded, including their spelling and spacing. Empty cells are labelled not available, and a 0 stays 0.
about.processingDerived: Data KUPS adds a few processed columns. In downloads, their names start with [Olahan Data KUPS] or [Pemeriksaan Data KUPS]:
about.processingRegion: official region codes from Minister of Home Affairs Decree No. 300.2.2-2138 of 2025 for every province and regency/city. All {pairs} name pairs in the source were matched, and the codes are the same as in the 2023 BIG (Geospatial Information Agency) boundary data. The matching has not yet been checked by hand.
about.processingJenis: PS type and record type (approval or designation);
about.processingYear: decree year, from the decree date column;
about.processingMembers: members, men + women, with separate totals for men and women;
about.processingFlags: review notes and links between records that share a decree number.
about.numbersLabel: Data KUPS calculated all totals and summary figures from the source records. They are not official national figures. You can recalculate any figure by filtering records on the Data page.
about.numbersRecords: Records: every record is counted, including records that share a decree number. Total {records}.
about.numbersArea: Area: sum of the Luas Area Keseluruhan (Ha) column over records where the value is present and not negative. Total {area} ha from {used} records. Records with an area-difference note are still counted.
about.numbersMembers: Members: sum of men + women over records where both values are present and not negative, including those that add up to 0. Total {members} from {used} records. {notUsed, plural, one {# record is} other {# records are}} not counted because of a negative value.
about.numbersSourceTotal: The source column Anggota Keseluruhan (total members) adds up to {sourceTotal} and is kept for comparison. Data KUPS does not use it to count members, because in {mismatch} records it equals the number of women.
about.duplicatesBody: {groups} decree numbers are used by more than one record, {records} records in total. All of these records are kept and counted. Each has a Duplicate label and links to the other records with the same decree number.
about.duplicatesTypes: {identical} records are identical to another record apart from the row number. The other {differs} share a decree number but differ in content, such as institution, region, or area.
about.duplicatesSpacing: Another {count} records have a decree number that differs from another record only in spacing or letter case. Data KUPS does not treat them as the same number, but links them.
about.checksLead: Data KUPS checks every record and adds a note when values are inconsistent. Notes do not change source values. Select a count to see those records.
about.limitsHomepage: Data KUPS figures differ from the achievement figures on the GoKUPS home page. According to notes in the source workbook, on {homeDate} the GoKUPS home page showed {homeInstitutions} institutions and {homeArea} ha. The retrieved register contained {records} decrees and {area} ha. GoKUPS does not explain the difference.
about.limitsRounding: Areas in the source are rounded to whole hectares.
about.limitsFemale: The number of women is 0 in {pct}% of records, including almost all decrees before 2017. The source does not distinguish 0 from not recorded, so the recorded number of women is probably lower than the real number. Read the number of women, and any comparison of men and women, with care. Every breakdown table shows how many records list 0 women.
about.limitsRecent: There are far fewer records dated {lastYears} than in earlier years ({recent}). Data for the most recent years is probably incomplete in the source.
about.limitsDistrict: Districts (kecamatan) are shown as source text and are not yet matched to official codes.
about.limitsRegion: The Region column in the workbook is not a GoKUPS field. The workbook's compiler filled it in from the province name.
about.mapBody: The dataset has no location coordinates for groups. So the Data KUPS map shows counts per province and regency/city on administrative boundaries, without location points. Regency/city boundaries come from BPS via OCHA and geoBoundaries (CC BY 3.0 IGO licence, as of 2020). Data KUPS gives each regency/city its 2025 Ministry of Home Affairs code, then builds the 38 provinces by merging those regencies/cities. Map boundaries are approximate, only for showing statistics, and are not a legal boundary reference. BIG boundary data is not used because permission to use it has not been confirmed.
about.excludedBody: All GoKUPS register columns are shown as recorded, including the names of institution chairs (Ketua Lembaga), pre-facilitators (Pra-Pendamping), and facilitators (Pendamping), and permit holders' names in the Nama Lembaga column. The managers decided to show them because these names are also public on the GoKUPS website. Names are shown as recorded in the source, without correction or masking.
about.numbersSex: Broken down: {male} men and {female} women. Both are summed over the same records, so they add up to {members}. The number of women is 0 in {zero} records.

flags.duplicate_sk: The decree number is also used by other records.
flags.duplicate_identical: Identical to another record with the same decree number.
flags.duplicate_attributes_differ: Shares a decree number with another record, but other columns differ.
flags.sk_spacing_variant: Decree number differs from another record only in spacing or letter case.
flags.sk_year_truncated: The year in the decree number has only 3 digits.
flags.date_after_extraction: Decree date is later than the data retrieval date.
flags.date_year_mismatch: The year in the decree number differs from the year of the decree date.
flags.area_zero: Total area in the source is 0.
flags.area_component_mismatch: Total area differs by more than 5 ha from the sum of area components. The area is still counted.
flags.area_component_rounding: Total area differs by 1 to 5 ha from the sum of area components. The area is still counted.
flags.area_missing: Total area is empty in the source.
flags.area_negative: Total area is negative in the source.
flags.members_total_column_mismatch: Anggota Keseluruhan (total members) does not equal men + women.
flags.members_total_equals_female: Anggota Keseluruhan (total members) equals the number of women.
flags.members_component_missing: Men or women count is empty in the source.
flags.institution_type_lphd_on_htr: Institution type recorded as Lembaga Pengelola Hutan Desa (village forest institution) under the Hutan Tanaman Rakyat scheme.
flags.kph_bengkulu_utara_outside_bengkulu: Forest management unit recorded as KPHP Bengkulu Utara, but the record is outside Bengkulu Province. Needs confirmation from the GoKUPS operator.
